items.title: Faster web-search MCP: quick-Google-and-answer
items.body: Improve JARVIS web search so asking a question triggers a quick web lookup and a spoken answer back, low-latency. Evaluate Browserbase (browserbase.com) as the browsing/search backend. Current web-search path needs to be faster + more reliable for ad-hoc questions.

items.title: Spacedrive-inspired app-wide restyle
items.body: Extend the wiki's Spacedrive visual language (--sd-* token ladder, 6px chrome, dimensional icons, cyan focus rings) app-wide: sidebar, top tab bar, tasks, captures, projects, settings, dialogs. Keep .glass-tile editorial register where intentional. GitHub issue #254.

items.title: Improve rest of app with the new look (start: briefing + tasks)
items.body: Propagate the genuine Spacedrive visual language (real tokens from .planning/SPACEDRIVE-TOKENS.md, post wiki-drive-fidelity redesign) to the rest of the app, STARTING with the briefing surface and tasks, then the remaining surfaces (captures, projects, settings, dialogs). Related: GH issue #254 (app-wide restyle) and bgsd item-c1112f6f — this refines it with the corrected, authentic token set.

items.title: Harden link-preview fetch (SSRF + unbounded body)
items.body: REVIEW.md sesh-1783791929518 MAJORs 1-2: apps/web/lib/link-preview/fetch.ts has no host/DNS private-IP filter (169.254.169.254/localhost/RFC1918 reachable, redirect: follow) and reads res.arrayBuffer() before the 1.5MB slice. Add IP filtering + streamed size cap.

items.title: Tauri hardening: CSP + child-webview isolation
items.body: REVIEW.md MAJOR 3: csp: null + withGlobalTauri: true while child-webviews load arbitrary external URLs. Define a CSP and restrict the global bridge.

items.title: Studio polish trio: orb drag listener leak, WhatsApp 30s poll, emitStudioAction userId
items.body: REVIEW.md MAJORs 4-6: OrbWidget leaks global pointer listeners on cancelled drags (add unmount cleanup); WhatsAppWidget 30s hard poll should use Realtime invalidation; add userId field to emitStudioAction so the bus is partitionable beyond the owner gate.

items.title: JARVIS HUD deferred follow-ups: Porcupine wake word, window management, local ElevenLabs key
items.body: From sesh-1783791929518 close-out: (1) Porcupine wake-word engine to replace the probe-based wake; (2) HUD window management (snap/tile/z-order); (3) refresh the stale local ElevenLabs key so local TTS stops 502ing; (4) deferred manual smoke: real spoken voice turn + hand-cursor camera opt-in.

items.title: Universal @mentions across the platform and JARVIS
items.body: First-class @mention system: typing @ anywhere (task descriptions, captures, wiki pages, chat with JARVIS, comments) opens an entity picker that can reference ANY entity — tasks, captures, projects, areas, people, wiki pages, events. Mentions render as rich inline chips that link to the entity, and JARVIS understands them in prompts ('add this to @Marathon-Training') and can emit them in replies. Needs: shared mention-autocomplete component, canonical entity-reference format (type:id), renderers per surface, and JARVIS tool/prompt support for resolving mentions.

items.title: Spacedrive UI refactor — EVERYTHING (desktop app, web app, all integrations)
items.body: Full Spacedrive-mode UI refactor across every surface: desktop HUD, entire web app, and all integration surfaces. Extends/supersedes #254 and the #256 canonical brief — user re-confirmed 2026-07-12 during Loop 4 testing: 'UI refactor into the spacedrive mode for everything: desktop app, web app, everything, and all the integrations.' Run as its own bgsd sesh.

items.title: Voice pipeline: stop partial+full utterance spawning two server turns
items.body: Upstream cause behind the Studio dup-widget/transcript defects (client-side mitigated in PR #284): wake-probe rolling tails + utterance-routine interception can run TWO full agentic turns for one spoken query (partial fires a routine turn, full fires a normal turn) — double cost/latency and two tool loops. Fix server-side: debounce/suppress a turn whose utterance is a strict prefix of a fuller one arriving within a short window, or gate routine interception on utterance finality. See .bgsd/seshs/studio-hud-1783966331/RESEARCH-implementation.md defect 2.

items.title: Captures: hashtag rail ignores inline #hashtags
items.body: Tester sd3 authed pass D2: left HASHTAGS rail shows 'No hashtags yet' while feed captures render inline hashtag chips (#calendar, #research, #implants). Rail likely keys off the extracted tags relation, not inline text. Decide: extract inline hashtags into the relation on capture create, or have the rail union both sources. Evidence frame: .bgsd/runs/sesh-sd3-allfeatures/review/authed-pass-1/captures-hashtag-rail-crop-dark.png
